Record the verification of data points

Source: R/verification.R
set_verification.Rd

Record the verification of data points

Usage

set_verification(
  path = ".",
  study_id,
  measurement_id,
  status = c("verified", "rejected", "unverified"),
  reviewer = NULL,
  note = NULL
)

Arguments

path

Project root.

study_id

Study identifier.

measurement_id

One or more measurement_ids in the study.

status

"verified", "rejected" (the value is wrong or should not be used) or "unverified" (removes an earlier decision).

reviewer

Reviewer name or initials. Defaults to the metawoRld.reviewer option, then the system user name.

note

Optional note, e.g. why a value was rejected.

Value

The updated verification table of the study, invisibly.
